name: vyapio
description: Vyapio — an AI-powered operating memory for neighbourhood businesses.

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace infrastructure run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace backend run test && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
